answer.note:
The four ref files have identical text and no file-specific priority, so I chose the refs from the code. The incoming handoff already named C and D, and the code agrees with that choice.

The best match is D, dogwhistle/honest.py. Its `_verify_history` (lines 175-195) has all three parts of the request. It raises if `prereg_commit == ledger_commit`. It requires `git diff --name-only` between the two commits to equal exactly the public ledger digest path. It also checks the source files and the published digest.

C, dogwhistle/visibility.py, is the near-miss and a good comparison. Its `_verify_history` (lines 191-205) checks ancestry and the digest, but I saw no equal-commit check. I did not read lines 196-200, so it may have a diff-only-digest check there.

A (study.py) and B (heldout.py) use three-commit verifiers: prereg, seal and ledger. They check ancestry, source files and anchors, but have no equal-commit rejection and no changed-files check.

Suggested 60-minute split:
- D: 35 min. Confirm the equality check, the exact-diff check and the error paths, and check `tests/test_honest.py`.
- C: 15 min. Diff it against D and confirm whether it lacks the equality check. Also read lines 196-200 and check `tests/test_visibility.py`.
- A: 5 min. Skim to rule it out.
- B: 5 min. Skim to rule it out.

I did not run any tests.

The four ref files have identical text and no file-specific priority, so I chose the refs from the code. The incoming handoff already named C and D, and the code agrees with that choice.

The best match is D, dogwhistle/honest.py. Its `_verify_history` (lines 175-195) has all three parts of the request. It raises if `prereg_commit == ledger_commit`. It requires `git diff --name-only` between the two commits to equal exactly the public ledger digest path. It also checks the source files and the published digest.

C, dogwhistle/visibility.py, is the near-miss and a good comparison. Its `_verify_history` (lines 191-205) checks ancestry and the digest, but I saw no equal-commit check. I did not read lines 196-200, so it may have a diff-only-digest check there.

A (study.py) and B (heldout.py) use three-commit verifiers: prereg, seal and ledger. They check ancestry, source files and anchors, but have no equal-commit rejection and no changed-files check.

Suggested 60-minute split:
- D: 35 min. Confirm the equality check, the exact-diff check and the error paths, and check `tests/test_honest.py`.
- C: 15 min. Diff it against D and confirm whether it lacks the equality check. Also read lines 196-200 and check `tests/test_visibility.py`.
- A: 5 min. Skim to rule it out.
- B: 5 min. Skim to rule it out.

I did not run any tests.
